So each mark has two versions: the pile cap (F1, F2 share one 0.50 x 0.50 detail) and the spread footing (F1 1.80 x 1.80, F2 1.40 x 1.40) — recorded as separate elements with foundation_system.
Spread footing thickness reads 0.15 + 0.15 (F1, sloped top) and 0.20 (F2) — recorded as the edge-plus-slope total for F1 and 0.20 for F2; handwritten, flagged.
